subject.title: [Feature]: Skip dispatch when message mentions a different account's bot

question: Should Matrix add a default-off gate that skips dispatch when a human room message explicitly mentions a different configured Matrix account, and should that gate be a new `ignoreOtherMentions`-style option or a change to `requireMention` semantics?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this adds Matrix config surface and dispatch-suppression semantics that affect channel routing compatibility and need maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Add Matrix ignoreOtherMentions
options.body: Add a Matrix-owned per-account/per-room boolean aligned with Slack and Discord semantics, defaulting to current behavior and dropping before typing/dispatch when another configured account is explicitly mentioned.

options.title: Extend requireMention semantics
options.body: Use an exclusive mention mode instead of a new boolean, accepting a more complex config contract and migration/docs path for a currently boolean field.

options.title: Defer to broader participation design
options.body: Keep this issue open until Matrix outbound sibling mention rendering or a broader room participation policy settles target detection and routing semantics.

recommendation.title: Add Matrix ignoreOtherMentions
recommendation.body: Add a Matrix-owned per-account/per-room boolean aligned with Slack and Discord semantics, defaulting to current behavior and dropping before typing/dispatch when another configured account is explicitly mentioned.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent Matrix `allowBots` policy in the same handler/schema/docs surface.
